phase: Sampling Audit — Restart from Project Objective
purpose: Audit the actual frozen MMR-1 temporal and spatial paired-observation contract before measuring sampling efficiency. Any efficiency result is valid only when it selects fewer corresponding SDR/HDR pairs from the unchanged full-resolution common grid.

frozen_mmr1_contract.application: Predict ICtCp Ct/Cp only, inverse to BT.2020, clamp negative RGB, then reimpose Model-E target luminance per frame.

source_paths.sdr_open_matte: G:\Filmy\IMAX format (open matte)\The Matrix (1999) [OPEN MATTE] [WEB-DL 1080p 10bit DD5.1 x265].mkv

synchronization.source: P2.32 LOCKED fixed offset, retained unchanged by Phase 6

matrix08_pair_contract.temporal_holdout: 90% is excluded from all production-eligible H0 and MMR fits and is applied only after fitting.

hdr_geometry.operation: cv2.INTER_LINEAR resize of full HDR RGB code values to 1920×800, before PQ EOTF
hdr_geometry.common_coordinate_mapping: common(x,y) maps to output HDR-resized(x,y); OpenCV source-center coordinate is ((x+0.5)/0.5-0.5, (y+0.5)/0.5-0.5).

matrix08_pair_contract.paired_observation: For every common integer (x,y), SDR is decoded at source (x,y+140) and HDR is read from the same (x,y) of the deterministic resized HDR common array. SDR and HDR are never independently sampled.

audit.coordinate_selection: Select twenty unique coordinates deterministically and evenly from the union of frozen MMR spatial training and heldout indices over the full 1920×800 common grid. The table must show all requested source and mapped coordinates and raw RGB48LE values.
audit_pass_requirements: all five frame pairs obey sdr_frame = hdr_frame - 19
raw decoded dimensions and bytes match the source contract
every common grid shape is exactly 1920×800
every diagnostic observation has shared common (x,y) coordinates
no analytical resize occurs after the HDR-to-common resize
all audit samples and full common arrays are finite
audit.physical_correspondence_limit: The audit proves code-level temporal/geometry contract and paired-coordinate construction. It does not claim unmeasured optical registration residual, motion/occlusion masking, or HDR truth outside the common region.

reference_fit.h0_luminance_rows: all full-resolution common-grid pixels from each training frame
reference_fit.sampling: deterministic evenly distributed rows from the frozen spatial train/held masks on the full 1920×800 grid; no image resize

reference_and_efficiency.candidate_lambda_holdout_pairs_per_train: min(50000, max(2048, round(train_pairs_per_frame/4))) deterministic rows from the unchanged frozen held mask; these are evaluation-only and excluded from the declared fit-pair budget.

frame_budgets_after_spatial_selection.reason: Required five-frame efficiency measurement; consumes the 90% temporal holdout and therefore cannot establish held-out temporal stability or determine the production recommendation.

required: reference-output equivalence across all five frames
seam continuity must not materially degrade from the reference
90% temporal holdout remains excluded from fit

reference_and_efficiency.recommendation: Smallest B1–B4 configuration meeting all acceptance requirements. B5 is not evaluated because it would consume the temporal holdout.

cross_scene.rule: Run only the chosen configuration and only on an already valid locally resolved Matrix shot plus a valid locally resolved BR2049 shot. Current Phase 6 allows none: Matrix 03 is ANCHOR_NEAR_CUT, Matrix 12 is LOCAL_SHOT_UNRESOLVED, BR2049 01 is ANCHOR_NEAR_CUT with conditional geometry 0.9155. Report EXCLUDED_BY_EXISTING_STATUS; do not find new anchors, widen windows, or change sync/geometry.

stop_rule: After audit, approved efficiency experiment, and status-limited cross-scene check, publish the report and stop. Do not modify MMR-1, production, geometry, synchronization, or process a full video.
